last_summary: Replication Seeder run 1 (gear 1, free). Mined the corpus for replications that ALREADY happened and filled the tip-jar: Yard 3->6 validations, 20->21 dossiers (19 quests). NEW VALIDATIONS: (1) LENR — Project Callisto null campaign, 2015-2024, >100 contributors, >40 F-P replications, 200k+ sample-hours, released 2026-09-08, no AHE anywhere in the tested space and prosaic explanations for most prior positives (confidence medium — corpus holds the scout record + 36-entry chapter catalog, NOT the report text); (2) ORGONE — Einstein's own 1941-01-13 test of Reich's accumulator: he measured the interior-vs-air temperature difference himself and got results similar to Reich's, then attributed it to floor/ceiling convection via the tabletop; Reich's four room control variants + open-air trial all reproduced the difference, Einstein never answered, no neutral party ever adjudicated (medium); (3) RADIESTHESIA — Chevreul 1812/1854: reproduced the Fortis explorer-pendulum AND its interposition-stop effect, then advanced a support along the arm until the fingers were immobilised and the motion ceased — the founding ideomotor demonstration, translated in full in-corpus (high for the demonstration, single-operator caveat). NEW DOSSIER 021 — Anomalous Heat Effect (LENR): the protocol the Yard was missing (it had 2 LENR validations and 0 LENR dossiers); encodes the corpus's own discrimination that heat claims need checklist-gated calorimetry while nuclear claims need products, so a heat result becomes interpretable instead of a 4th decade of ambiguity. Same silent-degradation family as the Yard empty-bug — the fix is to never regenerate non-Yard sections from a machine missing the shared corpus.
